order_balance.limitation: Balance removes deterministic ordinal-position imbalance but does not itself prove independence or stationarity of repeat signs. Preserve raw execution order/time metadata and randomize or otherwise predeclare cycle order.

multiplicity.conjunctive_intersection_union_note: If the only acceptance claim is B beats A AND B beats C, testing each component at alpha 0.05 and requiring both is already a level-0.05 intersection-union rule; R15's alpha 0.025 per gate is conservative but valid and also protects simultaneous component-wise claims.

power_scope.reason: A-B and C-B share B and their joint sign law is not fixed by the two marginal positive probabilities.

tie_protocol.reason: Gate-specific tie deletion can destroy analyzed six-order balance and can give A-B and C-B different effective n and order strata; 24 usable non-tied contrasts is not automatically four complete analyzed cycles.
tie_protocol.preferred_primary_fix: Freeze 24 scheduled physical A/B/C triplets in four complete six-order cycles and count delta==0 as non-success for each superiority gate. Keep n=24 and threshold 18/24.
tie_protocol.alternative: If tie deletion is retained, predeclare a bounded gate-specific replacement/stratification rule restoring order balance and state explicitly that the null is conditional on non-tied contrasts.

effect_size.information_loss_witness: The same positive/negative sign vector is compatible with arbitrarily small or much larger positive timing deltas.
effect_size.material_speedup_requirement: Predeclare a nonzero engineering margin epsilon and test signs of delta-epsilon, or explicitly limit the claim to epsilon=0 and report raw paired magnitudes separately. No numerical epsilon is inferred by this verifier.

contrast_scope.A_minus_B: end-to-end automatic-hybrid versus unmodified dense contrast, conditional on correctness and identical-input gates
contrast_scope.C_minus_B: effect of allowing sparse routing inside the guarded wrapper if B and C differ only by route permission; not a pure sparse-convolution arithmetic decomposition unless cache/allocation/control-state equivalence is also demonstrated
contrast_scope.A_minus_C: diagnostic/veto only; a significant positive A-C means the forced-fallback guarded control is unexpectedly faster than unmodified dense and blocks clean sparse-route attribution until diagnosed; non-significance is not equivalence

hard_gates: A/B/C numerical correctness and frozen invariants must pass before performance acceptance
B executes at least one sparse nonlinear call and C executes zero sparse calls
raw per-repeat deltas, ties, execution order, timestamps and route/cost decomposition retained
shadow dense numerical counterfactuals excluded from confirmatory production timing
native spectralDNS/shenfun/MPI/FFTW rerun and independent task-level acceptance remain outstanding
boundary: Finite experimental-design verification only. No native-host rerun, generic CFD/industrial acceleration, continuous-PDE theorem, mathematical acceptance, Working Truth or canonical promotion.
